subject: economics
objective: What is the inflation rate and the real interest rate?
instruction: Harbourview's CPI stood at 140 at the start of the year, the nominal interest rate is 6%, and the hourly wage rose from USD 22 to USD 23.10. The end-of-year CPI has not been published yet. Inflation is the percentage change in the CPI. Use the exact Fisher relation 1 + r = (1 + i) / (1 + inflation) for the real interest rate, its approximation r = i - inflation, and real wage growth = (1 + nominal wage growth) / (1 + inflation) - 1. Required: inflation rate, real interest rate, real wage growth.
